global: This is Tokyo-style tonkotsu ramen, featuring a rich, creamy broth with visible green onions. Toppings—chashu, nori, and menma—are artfully arranged in the bowl, which rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and Japanese text on rim, smooth glossy surface.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth with noodles appears creamy, pale yellow, and slightly oily, with visible strands and green garnish floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly tapered, rounded bowl shape.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed: dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface wrinkles and slight sheen.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice has pale pinkish-brown color, smooth texture, oval shape, and green onion specks on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear light brown, glossy, and slightly curled with visible fibrous texture and green specks.
